name: Byzantine Spacecraft Quarantine & Consensus Integrity
description: Tests adversarial cyber-physical resilience and Byzantine fault isolation (Master Blueprint v2.0 Section 3.13 & 3.14). Malicious or corrupted telemetry is injected into SAT-10 in Plane C at t=2.0s. Cross-verification by peer nodes detects severe telemetry inconsistency, triggering immediate trust degradation below the safety threshold (trust <= 0.40). The swarm autonomously isolates SAT-10 from consensus voting and constellation coordination, safeguarding swarm decision integrity.

scheduled_faults.description: Corrupted Byzantine telemetry and contradictory sensor values injected on SAT-10
